verified: Penguin Solutions showed the MemoryAI Photonic Appliance at SC26 with up to 576 GB of HBM3E plus 16 TB of DDR5, a 7.2 TB/s aggregate bandwidth target, CXL.mem 3.1 over optical links, and customer samples slated for the second half of 2027, according to Tom's Hardware's report from the show.
unconfirmed: Actual application performance, the claim of transparent access without application changes, the sub-350ns PF-NIC and sub-200ns chiplet latency figures (which exclude PCIe/CXL overhead), pricing, and where Penguin will source HBM3E in volume around 2028 as the industry moves to HBM4.

verified: Penguin Solutions 在 SC26 展出了该设备，Tom's Hardware 报道其 576GB HBM3E／16TB DDR5 容量、7.2 TB/s 聚合带宽目标、三种内存访问模式（HBM 直连、HBM 作 DDR5 写穿缓存、DDR5 直连）以及基于 Marvell PFMM 与 PF-NIC 的架构细节。
unconfirmed: 透明访问无需改应用、低于 350ns／200ns 的延迟（前者尚未计入 PCIe/CXL 开销）、2027 年下半年送样能否如期，以及多加速器共享后每张卡实际分到多少带宽——这些均无独立测试或第三方验证。

titles.en: Penguin demos photonic memory appliance with 576GB HBM3E over optical CXL at SC26
titles.zh: Penguin 展出光子外置内存：最高 576GB HBM3E，2027 下半年送样
